description: This file defines a final class 'Header' with static methods for parsing, normalizing, and splitting HTTP header values, specifically handling header string parsing and list splitting.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: A utility class for parsing and handling HTTP headers in PSR-7 context.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses header strings into an array of associative arrays representing key-value pairs.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Converts headers with comma-separated values into an array of individual headers (deprecated).

methods.name: splitList
methods.description: Splits a header string or array of strings into individual list items, handling quoted strings and escaped characters.
